# Original assets — do not edit, do not deploy

`photos-original/` holds the 29 unmodified photographs exactly as delivered
(2048 × 1365 JPEG, no EXIF rotation required). The web copies in
`public/assets/img/` were derived from these.

This directory sits outside `public/`, so it is never served. Regenerate the
web copies from here if sizing, compression or crops ever need to change.

Filename mapping (source → web slug) follows MLS display order 1–29; see the
`PHOTOS` array in `public/assets/js/main.js` for the slug, category and caption
assigned to each.

Not supplied by the client, and therefore absent: floor plan, video, virtual
tour, upgrade schedule, HOA documents, comparables, survey, seller's disclosure.

`mysti-stewart-original.jpg` is the unmodified agent headshot as supplied
(2000 x 2000 JPEG). The web copies in `public/assets/img/agent/` are a 4:5 crop
derived from it at 560w and 900w, WebP and JPEG.
